content.short: Fabric is the easiest way to crowdfund onchain.
content.description: Fabric is a crowdfinancing protocol implemented as a non-upgradable, EVM-compatible smart contract. It enables permissionless capital pooling and verifiable upside sharing, at the intersection of a crowdfunding project, an escrow account, and a cap table. How it works: a creator deploys a crowdfinancing contract on-chain; contributors deposit funds; if the goal is met, the recipient withdraws the pooled funds; otherwise contributors withdraw their deposits. Recipients may deposit the yield generated from deployed capital back into the contract, and contributors can withdraw a share of this yield proportional to their initial contribution.
